user.title: Loewe klang speaker
user.description: Enter the IP address or hostname of your Loewe klang (DTS Play-Fi) speaker.

confirm_move.title: Speaker address changed
confirm_move.description: {name} no longer answers at {old_host}, and a device at {new_host} claims to be it. Discovery messages are not authenticated, so only continue if you expected this speaker to get a new address. Move {name} to {new_host}?

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach a Play-Fi speaker at that address.

abort.already_in_progress: Setup for this speaker is already in progress.
abort.not_loewe: The discovered device is not a supported Play-Fi speaker.

init.title: Loewe klang options
init.description: Spotify Connect plays on the speaker itself, so only Spotify knows the track. Any Spotify account set up in Home Assistant that is playing on this speaker is shown automatically. Pick an entity here only to limit it to one account.

data_description.spotify_entity: Leave empty to detect automatically. Requires the Spotify integration.
